documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our construction services team struggles with disconnected teams. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's construction services team is struggling with 'disconnected teams' and seeks 'workflow coordination and account reporting.' They have requested a discovery meeting but have not approved a budget. The current stage is 'qualified' with consent granted, and no blocking prerequisites are in place.

We want workflow coordination and account reporting.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your construction services team is struggling with disconnected teams and that you're seeking workflow coordination and account reporting. To better understand your specific requirements, we'd like to schedule a discovery meeting. Could you please confirm a suitable time for this discussion?
questions: What specific workflows or processes are currently disconnected in your team?
Are there any existing tools or systems you're using that could be integrated with Cedar Systems?
What are your expectations for the account reporting functionality?
uncertainties: The customer has not approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
